items.title: How Kiro fixes itself, and how we keep the fixes honest
items.en_title: How Kiro fixes itself, and how we keep the fixes honest
items.en_oneliner: The Kiro team recounts a self-fix: one wrong sentence in a tool description was fed to the model 61,742 times before they caught it and proved the repair.

items.title: Voxtral 3
items.en_oneliner: Voxtral 3, Mistral's voice agent SDK, handles real-time speech in 50+ languages, precise transcription, expressive voice synthesis, and deep tool use.
